scope: Coverage of distinct high-value hypotheses on the verified OTTO interaction data. Counts are an inventory, not a percent complete or a proof of literal mathematical exhaustiveness.

families.decision: Evidence supports the published configuration within this scope; extensions have separate open entries.

families.name: Direct retrieval-source evidence
families.scope: The original source score/rank/presence/share family; its removal improved the frozen selection result. This does not exclude every candidate rank feature.

families.name: Original intent interactions

families.decision: Evidence supports the published configuration within this scope; extensions have separate open entries.

families.name: Wider and directional graph features
families.scope: 144 proposed affinities on the exact baseline candidate rows and original 102 features.
families.remaining_question: Matched raw-pool additions reduce the weighted point estimate. Normalization removes that point loss but its paired interval includes zero; task-specific utility and richer support remain untested.
families.next_experiment: Reuse certified caches for fitting-only task utility screening. Keep original candidates, negatives and baseline columns fixed.

families.name: As-of demand, popularity ranks and drift
families.scope: Historical demand updated using an explicit timestamp-availability policy.
families.remaining_question: Does the fixed historical cutoff make popularity stale, and can item ranks, growth acceleration or hour/week interactions improve it?
families.next_experiment: Compare frozen history with rolling as-of snapshots; exclude all label suffixes and embargo incomplete conversion windows.

families.name: Action sequence, funnel and episode context
families.scope: Prefix action transitions, repeat bursts, item last-action state, entropy/concentration and episodes separated by observed gaps.
families.remaining_question: The larger frozen shortlist scores 0.595073 versus 0.589870; all five block removals lower point recall, but every block interval spans zero and one time quartile regresses. Does the unchanged representation transfer to earlier cutoffs with adequate target support? The degree block has only +0.029 pp conditional point contribution.
families.next_experiment: Run the frozen temporal-input preflight and matched earlier-window replication in configs/shared_feature_confirmation.json. Preserve the full 32 additions; no block combination search or promotion. Each stage is capped at 900 seconds.

families.name: Smoothed historical propensity and categorical encoding
families.scope: Support-adjusted item/transition propensities and chronological out-of-fold target encodings.
families.remaining_question: Do historical count ratios benefit from shrinkage and support measures, especially for rare items?
families.next_experiment: Start with empirical-Bayes historical rates; if label-derived encodings are used, fit only on earlier complete sessions with an embargo and unseen-item fallback. Never encode each row with its own future targets.

families.name: Popularity-normalized graph and higher-order intent
families.scope: Lift/PMI, row-normalized transitions, neighbor rank, support and cross-action transitions.
families.remaining_question: The larger frozen shortlist scores 0.595073 versus 0.589870; all five block removals lower point recall, but every block interval spans zero and one time quartile regresses. Does the unchanged representation transfer to earlier cutoffs with adequate target support? The degree block has only +0.029 pp conditional point contribution.
families.next_experiment: Run the frozen temporal-input preflight and matched earlier-window replication in configs/shared_feature_confirmation.json. Preserve the full 32 additions; no block combination search or promotion. Each stage is capped at 900 seconds.

families.name: Multi-hop and complementary graph discovery
families.scope: Bounded two-hop graph paths with task-dependent aggregation.
families.remaining_question: Can paths through intermediate items find incremental positives beyond direct neighbors?
families.next_experiment: Reuse certified historical graphs; measure overlap and unique positives at fixed budgets before fitting matched rankers. Exclude self loops and cap hubs.

families.name: Learned Item2Vec similarities and retrieval
families.scope: Two historical 128-dimensional Item2Vec spaces; four feature-only arms are measured.
families.remaining_question: Does the small/no weighted feature gain reflect redundancy, poor coverage, objective mismatch, or inadequate retrieval complementarity?
families.next_experiment: Audit per-action coverage and gain; reuse saved vectors for a bounded ANN candidate-union test before any further embedding training.

families.name: Implicit matrix-factorization signals
families.scope: Historical item/session factors learned from interaction weights.
families.remaining_question: Do collaborative latent factors add information beyond co-visitation and local sequence embeddings?
families.next_experiment: Fit one bounded implicit factorization on historical sessions; compare candidate affinity and cold-item coverage with existing vectors.

families.name: Session-neighbor and sequence alignment
families.scope: Historical nearest-session neighbors, recency weights and order-aware similarity.
families.remaining_question: Can similar baskets from earlier sessions supply complementary items without a neural encoder?
families.next_experiment: Fit a bounded historical session index and test incremental coverage; ablate binary overlap, inverse-frequency and order weighting.

families.name: Task-conditioned neural retrieval
families.scope: Historical two-tower/sequence retrieval with next-click versus multi-positive cart/order targets.
families.remaining_question: Does the earlier fold benefit reproduce under the current corpus cutoff and unchanged ranker?
families.next_experiment: Recertify or refit with exact historical cutoffs; compare raw retrieval, candidate union and ranking features separately. Use fixed seeds and an explicit hard-negative policy.

families.name: Multiple session interests
families.scope: Separate representations of recent activity, cart/order interest and diverse prefix items.
families.remaining_question: Last-item, recent-distinct and cart/order-distinct graph pools have been measured as blocks; their individual contributions and vector-based multi-interest representations are unresolved.
families.next_experiment: Ablate query pools using existing graphs/vectors before training a new multi-intent encoder. Nearly half the selection prefixes have one event; report opportunity by prefix support.

families.name: Repeat-versus-new relevance
families.scope: Observed-item versus novel-item likelihood and task-specific routing.
families.remaining_question: Can clicks improve by handling revisits differently while preserving cart/order performance?
families.next_experiment: Select repeat/new feature interactions and routing only on development data; report disjoint hit/denominator slices, including missed candidates.

families.name: Candidate budget, consensus and relative ranks
families.scope: Complementary source unions, source disagreement, full-query ranks and 400/800/1200 frontiers.
families.remaining_question: Do additional candidates help only when paired with source-aware features and sufficient ranker training coverage?
families.next_experiment: Compare nested candidate unions at fixed task budgets and full-query normalized ranks computed before negative sampling; report recall, overlap, latency and memory.

families.scope: Per-objective feature selection, feature interactions and adequate negative/session coverage.

families.name: Text, image, price and product semantics
families.scope: Current verified OTTO competition inputs only.
families.data_constraint: Only session, item, timestamp and action type are verified.
families.exclusion_reason: The verified OTTO schema provides no item descriptions, images, prices, categories or inventory. Anonymous IDs cannot supply product meaning.

families.name: Persistent user attributes and cross-session user history
families.scope: Current verified OTTO competition inputs only.
families.data_constraint: Only session, item, timestamp and action type are verified.
families.exclusion_reason: A session identifier is not a verified persistent shopper identity. No supplied customer profile, geography or reliable identity link is available.

temporal_confirmation.reason: The original nine cells confirm the original procedure. Newly selected features require preregistered temporal confirmation with prior data exposure declared.

next_task: Keep feature engineering open. Preflight the frozen 32-feature challenger at an earlier historical cutoff: verify corpus/retriever hashes, audit 256 complete queries per role, then measure a 1,024-session build before a bounded baseline/shared temporal replication. All five block removals reduced point recall, but their intervals span zero and one query-time quartile regresses. Preserve the accepted baseline; broader query-relative/as-of demand, latent/session-neighbor and neural-complementarity hypotheses remain open.
